name: Rashmi
description: Rashmi is an elven aether researcher and inventor of Ghirapur whose matter transporter won the Inventors' Fair and became the basis of the Planar Bridge.

summary.text: Rashmi is an elven aether researcher and inventor of Ghirapur whose matter transporter won the Inventors' Fair and became the basis of the Planar Bridge.

bio.text: Rashmi built a matter transporter around her aether condenser for the Inventors' Fair, working with her assistant and research partner Mitul.
After her friend Saheeli supplied a new filament, the transporter successfully moved a vase across the room, and Rashmi and Mitul presented it to Padeem.
Rashmi was declared top prize winner of the Fair, after which prizewinning inventions were quietly taken by guards and Tezzeret said her work would be his focus.

Tezzeret held her as his captive patronage inventor in the Aether Spire and threatened to kill her, and when her transporter let her glimpse many other worlds he laughed and claimed the device as his.
She chose to save Mitul, rigged the transporter so Tezzeret's demonstration backfired, leapt from the window on a harness cable, and was rescued by Saheeli.
Joining the renegade movement, she finished the skyship, felt Kiran's spirit in it, dedicated it as the Heart of Kiran, and decided to stay.
With Pia and Saheeli she revealed Hope of Ghirapur, a modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor meant to cripple the Planar Bridge.

status.text: The last story featuring her shows her alive and free among the renegades, having sworn that her Planar Bridge work will not be duplicated; a 2025 mention only recalls how her Planar Bridge revealed other worlds.

timeline.summary: Rashmi builds a matter transporter around her aether condenser for the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: But only Rashmi had a device capable of powering such a venture.

timeline.summary: Test subject 848, a flower, disintegrates in the transporter.
timeline.quote: Trial failed. Test subject 848 disintegrated,

timeline.summary: Mitul notes traces of transmuted matter, and they plan a more stable aether stream.
timeline.quote: measurements detected traces of transmuted matter

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul face qualifiers within a week, hoping for the Consulate's support.
timeline.quote: The Inventors' Fair qualifiers were less than a week away.

timeline.summary: On the afternoon of the qualifiers, exhausted, they prepare their last trial with test subject 887.
timeline.quote: It was the afternoon of Inventors' Fair qualifiers, and they had not yet run a successful trial.

timeline.summary: The 887th flower implodes and the filament snaps.
timeline.quote: POP! The flower imploded.

timeline.summary: Rashmi begins to confess that the inquirium is in financial trouble.
timeline.quote: I should have told you long ago.

timeline.summary: Mitul points out that the vase from the table has been transported across the room into a circle.
timeline.quote: There, leaning against the wall inside a small inscribed circle, was the vase.

timeline.summary: Mitul confirms they transported inorganic matter across space.
timeline.quote: We successfully transported inorganic matter across space.

timeline.summary: Mitul admits they have no spare filament.
timeline.quote: We do not have another filament.

timeline.summary: Fair automatons hawk attractions at Rashmi and Mitul and block their way to the market.
timeline.quote: Welcome to the Inventors' Fair!

timeline.summary: Remi's shop has no WP series filament and no restock for days.
timeline.quote: The back's as cleared-out as the storefront.

timeline.summary: Every shop in Ghirapur turns out to be out of the needed filament.
timeline.quote: It seemed that there wasn't a WP series filament in all of Ghirapur.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken, Rashmi tells Mitul they must close the inquirium and walks away.
timeline.quote: Mitul, we're going to have to close down the inquirium.

timeline.summary: Saheeli finds Rashmi at the inquirium and learns the filament broke.
timeline.quote: The bright young inventor was standing in the middle of the workshop

timeline.summary: Saheeli offers to speak to Padeem about the aether condenser.
timeline.quote: I know Padeem well enough.

timeline.summary: Rashmi tells Saheeli about the working matter transporter.
timeline.quote: Mitul and I designed a matter transporter, and it works!

timeline.summary: Saheeli refuses to help, saying the device is too dangerous.
timeline.quote: It's too dangerous.

timeline.summary: Rashmi accuses Saheeli of jealousy as she leaves.
timeline.quote: Are you jealous?

timeline.summary: Saheeli offers a new filament and says Padeem will give Rashmi an audience if it works.
timeline.quote: Padeem promised me she would give you an audience if it works.

timeline.summary: The transporter successfully moves the vase across the room, and Saheeli hopes she did the right thing.
timeline.quote: The ring floated up from the table, and as it did, the vase flickered away.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she bought Padeem's audience with a front-row duel seat.
timeline.quote: A front-row seat at the underground artificer duel next month.

timeline.summary: Rashmi learns that Padeem was once an underground quicksmith.
timeline.quote: The best of her time,

timeline.summary: Saheeli apologizes and she and Rashmi reconcile.
timeline.quote: Rashmi drew Saheeli into an embrace.

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul present the transporter to Padeem, who tells Rashmi to impress her.
timeline.quote: All right, Inventor Rashmi, impress me.

timeline.summary: The announcer declares Rashmi top prize winner of the Fair and prizewinning inventions are quietly taken by guards.
timeline.quote: An announcer was proclaiming that Rashmi had won top prize at the Fair

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
timeline.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals that Rashmi's work has staggering implications larger than Kaladesh and will be his focus.
timeline.quote: Rashmi's work for the fair had staggering implications.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she has found where Tezzeret is hiding, in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire, where he holds the winning inventor.
timeline.quote: He has locked himself away in a private workshop, hidden in the central Aether Spire.

timeline.summary: Rashmi works alone in the Spire Inquirium, missing her assistant Mitul whom the functionaries refuse to bring.
timeline.quote: It had been four weeks since she'd asked for Mitul to be brought on

timeline.summary: Rashmi notices that aerowright Sana's workstation was emptied after Tezzeret's first progress check.
timeline.quote: The sight of aerowright Sana's empty workstation dissolved any spirit of comradery

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives for a progress check and bends Bhavin's automaton's arm, then throws Bhavin out and takes his invention.
timeline.quote: "You've failed. Get out."

timeline.summary: Rashmi presents the scaled-up transporter and works out the answer to Tezzeret's nonlinear-transport question.
timeline.quote: If I insert an attenuator into the aether-loop

timeline.summary: Tezzeret has a functionary dismissed for objecting to rerouting aether and threatens to terminate Rashmi if she cannot move Bhavin's automaton by the next check.
timeline.quote: "If you don't, you will be terminated."

timeline.summary: Four weeks later, the other inventors have been moved out, and Rashmi, pushed to exhaustion, finishes the transporter on the morning of the progress check.
timeline.quote: "It's finished."

timeline.summary: Setting the target, Rashmi's mind is pulled through the phantom dimensions and she glimpses many other worlds before Tezzeret's footsteps pull her back.
timeline.quote: And then she was Rashmi, the elf, kneeling on the floor in the Inquirium

timeline.summary: Rashmi tells Tezzeret of the phantom dimensions; he laughs at her, declares the transporter his, and dismisses her.
timeline.quote: "This beautiful creation is now mine. And thus I am done with you."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret threatens to kill Rashmi and then bring Mitul to complete the transporter and kill him too, and sends functionaries to fetch Mitul.
timeline.quote: I will bring your little friend—Mitul, I believe was his name—to complete the transporter

timeline.summary: Rashmi chooses to save Mitul over the dimensions she has seen.
timeline.quote: And she would choose Mitul.

timeline.summary: Rashmi secretly sends a warning note to Mitul through the old transporter ring while distracting Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: dropping the ball of paper through the ring. It disappeared.

timeline.summary: Rashmi rigs the transporter so the demonstration backfires; Tezzeret's test sends the automaton onto a box, crushing the desk and shattering the window.
timeline.quote: Too big to fit, Bhavin's masterpiece crushed the box

timeline.summary: Rashmi leaps out of the window on a harness cable and escapes Tezzeret above Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: she sprinted to the gaping hole and leapt out into the swirling aether beyond.

timeline.summary: Saheeli rescues Rashmi in her construct and tells her Mitul is safe.
timeline.quote: "He's safe," Saheeli said.

timeline.summary: Rashmi realizes Saheeli knew the transporter's implications and senses the planeswalker nature in her; Saheeli welcomes her to the renegade movement.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend. I have much to tell you."

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul finish the skyship while renegades are away, Rashmi planning to leave and stop inventing afterward.
timeline.quote: This was the last thing she would make that would be used for harm.

timeline.summary: Rashmi finds the initials K.N. on the skyship and feels Kiran's spirit and love of invention through the filigree.
timeline.quote: Two letters, carefully carved by an artistic hand: K.N.

timeline.summary: Rashmi realizes the revolution is about the spirit of invention and decides to stay.
timeline.quote: There was more to this skyship, more to this revolution, than she had allowed herself to see.

timeline.summary: Rashmi dedicates the skyship as the Heart of Kiran, and Mitul and Rashmi remain to pursue temporal aether research.
timeline.quote: So I dedicate this skyship the Heart of Kiran,

timeline.summary: Pia, Saheeli and Rashmi reveal Hope of Ghirapur, a modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor to cripple the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "Rashmi and Saheeli have designed a specially modified thopter," said Pia.

timeline.summary: Saheeli discovers the hollowed-out thopter; the group debates calling off the attack.
timeline.quote: "We need to call it off," he said.

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes to be the disruptor herself by riding the thopter into the Bridge; Gideon objects but she insists.
timeline.quote: "From close range, I could be the disruptor.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims credit for Rashmi's invention and taunts Liliana about Jace and the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She would have been sending vases across Ghirapur forever if I hadn't guided her tiny little mind.

timeline.summary: Ishikari climbs her workshop tower, recalling how Rashmi's Planar Bridge revealed other worlds.
timeline.quote: Up the stairs she goes.

pages_say.description: An elven aether researcher who lives in the inquirium, follows the Great Conduit, and builds a matter transporter from her aether condenser to win the Inventors' Fair.
An elven inventor who won top prize at the Fair, taken with her invention.
An inventor whose work for the Fair has staggering implications that Tezzeret wants to pursue.
An ingenious aether scientist of Ghirapur.
The winning inventor of the Fair and Saheeli's friend, held by Tezzeret.
An elvish aether-seer whose matter transporter won the Inventors' Fair; she becomes Tezzeret's captive patronage inventor and escapes after glimpsing other planes.
The elvish aether-engineer who completes the skyship, feels Kiran's spirit and names it the Heart of Kiran.
The aether-engineer who designed Hope of Ghirapur to undo her own earlier invention.
The inventor whose transporter became the planar portal.
The inventor who has sworn her Planar Bridge will not be duplicated.
An inventor whose Planar Bridge revealed other worlds to Ishikari and who declined to recommend her.
